statement: A corporation formed outside California that transacts intrastate business in California must qualify with the Secretary of State by filing a Statement and Designation by Foreign Corporation (Form S&DC-S/N, $100 for a stock corporation) accompanied by a current certificate of good standing from its home jurisdiction and signed by a corporate officer; a qualified foreign corporation then owes the $800 minimum franchise tax each year and files the annual Statement of Information.
caveat: What counts as 'transacting intrastate business' is a Corporations Code § 191 / § 2105 analysis that this card does not resolve — remote employees, offices, and repeated in-state transactions each need their own look. Fees and form revisions change; verify the live SOS forms page.
